subject: general
question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are (2x - 5y + 3) m, (5x + 7y - 7) m, and (x + y + 3) m, respectively. Find the perimeter of the cuboid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter** of a **cuboid** = 4 × (Length + Breadth + Height)

Sum of terms = (2x + 5x + x) + (−5y + 7y + y) + (3 − 7 + 3) = 8x + 3y − 1

Perimeter = 4 × (8x + 3y − 1) = 32x + 12y − 4

**∴ The correct answer is (32x + 12y − 4) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (l)** = (2x − 5y + 3) m

**Breadth (b)** = (5x + 7y − 7) m

**Height (h)** = (x + y + 3) m

**Formula Used:**

**Perimeter of Cuboid** = 4(l + b + h)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5003af47f53029511f4c920eb7ecc52d203fea1d0461fd5dd66cf879b936077e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = (2x − 5y + 3) + (5x + 7y − 7) + (x + y + 3)

⇒ Sum = (2x + 5x + x) + (−5y + 7y + y) + (3 − 7 + 3)

⇒ Sum = 8x + 3y − 1

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × (8x + 3y − 1)

⇒ Perimeter = 32x + 12y − 4

**∴ The correct answer is (32x + 12y − 4) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces is given by 2(lb + bh + hl).

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Length × Breadth × Height.

Diagonal of Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside is √(l² + b² + h²).</p
